title_en: Chinese Science Fiction (18/20): An Answer from the Deep
note_en: Look at 随着 in 这些生物的身体会随着船只的灯光改变颜色 "the creatures' bodies changed color along with the ship's lights." 随着 means "following / as … changes," and the whole 随着 phrase sits before the verb, just like other time and manner phrases in Chinese, whereas English puts "in response to the lights" after the verb. The same text also uses 会 for typical behavior (会改变颜色 "would change color"), not for the future.
